items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 2026-11-20. The 30-day period runs 'ab Rechnungsdatum' (from the invoice date), which is treated as the triggering event, so under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the invoice itself is not counted and the period starts the next day, 2026-11-21. Counting 30 days forward from 2026-11-20 lands on 2026-12-20. That calendar day, 2026-12-20, is a Sunday. Under §193 BGB, when the last day of a period for a declaration or payment falls on a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday, the period ends on the next working day. 2026-12-21 is a Monday and not a public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen, so the payment is due on 2026-12-21.
